Hi Michael,

Sorry about that. I've checked the order and you're right: the Overclocking Bundle on Shop···· went out from our Rotterdam warehouse with a EU lead, and it should have been the UK one for your (address hidden). That's a packing error on our side, not anything you did.

There's nothing to send back. The correct UK lead needs to be raised by a colleague as a free shipment to you, and I've put it in front of the team with your address and the order already on it, so nothing more is needed from you. They're online from 10am Eastern today and it comes back to you at this address.

Please don't use the kit with a travel adapter in the meantime, just leave it until the right lead arrives.

Your Nexus S1 label is still marked urgent for them this morning on the other thread, and I'll keep chasing that one too.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
Great thanks again for the help
